prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are helpful, yielding 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, producing 2 significant wins (+11.4%, +7.2%), while 4 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-10.9%) and 1 test with no clear effect.
adoption, copy; sign_in, hint; and home, notification changes showed no clear effect across all tested iterations.
sign_in, reorder and choose_path, redesign changes remain inconsistent, each producing 1 significant win and 1 significant loss.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak ideas and underestimate large wins, and evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Practice Flow: Integrate an interactive mini-practice sequence directly into the final onboarding stage where users try clicking, summoning, and docking their desktop pet. (why: Lessons show finish step new_flow changes produce massive wins (+11.4%, +7.2%), and support received multiple complaints about confusion over controlling or hiding pets post-onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Hotkey Setup Screen: Insert a new screen after home intro letting users configure and test custom desktop shortcuts to quick-hide or call their pet. (why: Support mail highlighted user confusion regarding how to control or hide pets, and adding new interactive finish flows leverages high-impact onboarding wins.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Activity Log: Show a real-time system status log on the wait screen showing desktop overlay initialization milestones. (why: Home wait info optimization consistently delivers significant conversion wins while keeping users informed during long setup times.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Docking Practice Flow: Add an interactive practice flow on the home intro screen guiding users to drag their pet into the desktop system tray. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and managing pets, while finish step new flows have delivered +11.4% retention gains.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Account Recovery Split Screen Sign-In: Reorganize the sign in screen into a split layout separating new account creation from existing pet account recovery. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating returning users accidentally create duplicate fresh accounts.)
5: [finish, redesign] Interactive Pet Home Stage Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive stage environment where the pet reacts live to user mouse hover. (why: Redesigning the final milestone reinforces companion value and boosts final onboarding completion (currently overall 37.5%).)
6: [home, wait_info] Companion Trait Teaser Ticker: Add an animated trait preview ticker on the waiting screen highlighting surprise behaviors the user's pet will exhibit. (why: Wait info changes on the generation step consistently produce wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +1.7%) by maintaining user delight during lengthy loads.)
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Mode Overview Screen: Add a new introductory screen before path selection detailing how desktop companions integrate into daily workspace habits. (why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates users lack clear understanding of how desktop pets function before committing to a path.)
